i1.title: Adidas Vibes Energy Drive Eau de Parfum 50ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
A zesty, spicy shot of energy.

Adidas Vibes Energy Drive Eau de Parfum 50ml is part of the 2024 Adidas Vibes mood-fragrance collection, created to give you a boost of energy. Bergamot, pink pepper, grapefruit and orange open brightly, a heart of cardamom, clary sage and violet leaves follows, and it settles on cashmeran, vetiver, tonka bean and musk.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Grapefruit, Orange
  • Heart: Cardamom, Clary Sage, Violet Leaves
  • Base: Cashmeran, Vetiver, Tonka Bean, Musk

Key details

  • Brand: Adidas
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 50ml
  • Scent profile: Fresh · Citrus · Spicy
  • Wear: Unisex

Why you'll love it

  • Key notes of cardamom and pink pepper
  • Designed to boost your energy
  • Eau de Parfum strength in a handy 50ml
  • Fresh, zesty and easy to wear

FAQ

What does Vibes Energy Drive smell like?

Bergamot, pink pepper, grapefruit and orange first, then cardamom, clary sage and violet leaves, finishing with cashmeran, vetiver, tonka bean and musk.

Is it unisex?

Yes, it is made for everyone.

seo.description: Adidas Vibes Energy Drive Eau de Parfum 50ml: pink pepper and grapefruit over cardamom, vetiver and tonka. Free UK delivery over £40.

i5.title: Adidas Pure Game Eau de Toilette 100ml
i5.descriptionHtml:
A sporty, woody-spicy classic.

Adidas Pure Game Eau de Toilette 100ml is a woody, spicy fragrance first launched in 2010. Pepper, basil, grapefruit and mandarin open with energy, a heart of cypress, guaiac wood and lavender follows, and it settles on tonka bean, incense, patchouli and sandalwood.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Pepper, Basil, Grapefruit, Mandarin
  • Heart: Cypress, Guaiac Wood, Lavender
  • Base: Tonka Bean, Incense, Patchouli, Sandalwood

Key details

  • Brand: Adidas
  • Concentration: Eau de Toilette
  • Size: 100ml
  • Scent profile: Woody · Spicy · Aromatic
  • Wear: Men

Why you'll love it

  • A lively opening of pepper, basil and grapefruit
  • A woody heart of cypress and guaiac wood
  • A warm base of tonka, incense and sandalwood
  • Great value everyday fragrance

FAQ

What does Pure Game smell like?

Pepper, basil, grapefruit and mandarin first, then cypress, guaiac wood and lavender, finishing with tonka bean, incense, patchouli and sandalwood.

Is it for men?

Yes, it is a men's fragrance.
